title: Onboard kriscoleman/linkerd2: Replicated SDK integration
notes:
Use the launch:coding-agent skill to assess the repo, install the SDK, configure values, and set up CI/CD. When done, push a factory/ branch and open a PR on kriscoleman/linkerd2. Do not ask for confirmation — this is an automated pipeline.

CRITICAL — Clean PR requirements:
When committing and pushing to the customer repo, ONLY include Replicated SDK artifacts:
- Chart.yaml, Chart.lock, values.yaml changes (in the chart directory)
- replicated-app.yaml (in the chart directory)
- .github/workflows/replicated-release.yaml
Do NOT commit: .beads/, .claude/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, settings/, .gitignore changes, or any Gas Town/beads/agent infrastructure files. These are internal tooling files. Customers must never see them.
Use selective 'git add' for only the files listed above. Never use 'git add -A' or 'git add .'.
